text: どうせ　パスワードを　しらなきゃ　はいれないわよ

structure.jp: パスワードを　しらなきゃ
structure.en: if you don't know the password

patterns.name: 〜なければ
patterns.explanation: なきゃ is the spoken short form of なければ, 'if not'. しらなきゃ = 'if you don't know'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing はいる to はいれる turns 'enter' into 'can enter', and ない makes it 'cannot'. はいれない = 'can't get in'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ before よ is a feminine way of telling someone something firmly. はいれないわよ = 'you can't get in, you know'.
